name: Starved Sea Drake
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-23: An Agent's Obligation

defensiveAbilities.name: Electrified Blood
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An adjacent creature deals piercing or slashing damage to the sea drake

Effect An arc of electricity courses through the sea drake's blood. The triggering creature takes 1d6 Electricity Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ball Lightning Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The sea drake spews a ball of electricity that strikes a primary target within 100 feet, dealing 6d6 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save). The lightning then arcs to up to three secondary targets within 30 feet of the primary target, striking the closest available targets first. The secondary bolts each strike one secondary target and deal the same rolled damage value as the primary bolt (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save).

The sea drake can't use Ball Lightning Breath again for 1d6 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Briny Wound
offensiveAbilities.description:
A sea drake's saliva carries a large quantity of salt, making its bite wounds even more painful. When a creature takes damage from a sea drake's jaws Strike, the creature must attempt a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save; the creature is then temporarily immune to briny wound for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Sickened 2 and Slowed 1 as long as it's sickened.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The sea drake makes one jaws Strike and two tail Strikes in any order.
